configuration.basis: explicit GAAP/ADJUSTED and independently identified accounting definition/scope accounting_basis_id; currency USD; EPS diluted/basic independently identified; revenue consolidated

configuration.guid_revision: current qualified midpoint minus prior qualified midpoint, native units; floor/ceiling no midpoint

configuration.price_denominator: last completed admitted exchange-session close strictly before original actual issue; genuine availability and comparable currency/share basis; no reaction price
configuration.prior: latest strictly earlier comparable original guidance for exact target/basis/currency/unit/share/calendar identity; separate original target-identity blocker union survives duplicate/conflicting/unusable value evidence; unknown scope only within source-stated target; latest unusable issue blocks stale fallback; equal-clock ambiguity missing; never text-prior fallback
configuration.target: exact source FY/FQ/period type/end and historical fiscal_calendar_id; never inferred date
configuration.values: source low/high only for range or one-sided bound; source point only for point quote; separately derived midpoint for complete range/point
